description: This file defines the CameraActivity class, which is an Android activity hosting the CameraFragment. It sets the theme dynamically based on intent extras and initializes the activity with a specific layout.

classes.name: CameraActivity
classes.description: Main activity class that hosts the camera interface, extends Android's Activity class, and manages lifecycle including theme setting and layout.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the activity is created; sets the theme based on intent extras and inflates the camera layout.
